Public HeldSort As Sort
Public HeldField As SortField
Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant,q As Object
If IsObject(CallByName(o,k,VbGet)) Then
Set q=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If q Is Nothing Then
P="Nothing"
ElseIf TypeName(q)="Range" Then
P="Range:" & q.Parent.Name & "!" & q.Address
Else
P=TypeName(q) & ":" & q.Name
End If
Else
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
P=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SetP(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
SetP="OK:" & P(o,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
SetP="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function M(o As Object,k As String,Optional a As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant
If IsMissing(a) Then
v=CallByName(o,k,VbMethod)
Else
v=CallByName(o,k,VbMethod,a)
End If
M=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
M="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function AddKey(s As Sort,k As Range,Optional direction As Long=1,Optional data As Long=0) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim f As SortField
Set f=s.SortFields.Add(k,0,direction,,data)
AddKey=TypeName(f) & ":" & P(f,"Key")
Exit Function
Failed:
AddKey="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,t As ListObject,s As Sort,c As Range,f As SortField,out As String
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
Set t=ws.ListObjects(1)
Set s=t.Sort
out="table=" & t.Name & ":" & t.Range.Address & ":headers=" & CStr(t.ShowHeaders) & ":totals=" & CStr(t.ShowTotals) & ";sort=" & P(s,"Rng") & ":h=" & P(s,"Header") & ":case=" & P(s,"MatchCase") & ":orientation=" & P(s,"Orientation") & ":method=" & P(s,"SortMethod") & ":fields=" & CStr(s.SortFields.Count) & "["
For Each f In s.SortFields
out=out & P(f,"Key") & ":" & P(f,"Order") & ":" & P(f,"DataOption") & "|"
Next
out=out & "];cells=["
For Each c In t.Range.Cells
out=out & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":nf=" & CStr(c.NumberFormat) & ":b=" & CStr(c.Font.Bold) & ":fill=" & CStr(c.Interior.Color) & "|"
Next
out=out & "];hidden=["
For Each c In t.Range.Rows
out=out & CStr(c.Row) & ":" & CStr(c.EntireRow.Hidden) & "|"
Next

Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim ws As Worksheet,t As ListObject,s As Sort,f As SortField,r As ListRow,v As Variant,out As String
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value=Array("Name","Qty","Double")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("pear",3)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("apple",1)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("plum",2)
ws.Range("A5:B5").Value=Array("apple",1)
Set t=ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange,ws.Range("A1:C5"),,xlYes)
t.Name="Items"
t.ListColumns(3).DataBodyRange.FormulaR1C1="=RC[-1]*10"
ws.Range("A2").Font.Bold=True
ws.Range("B2").NumberFormat="0.00"
ws.Range("A2").Interior.Color=vbYellow
Set s=t.Sort
out="table-typed=" & EarlyRng(s) & ";table-object=" & DirectRange(s,"Rng") & ";table-callbyname=" & P(s,"Rng") & ";sheet-typed=" & EarlyRng(ws.Sort)
Set f=s.SortFields.Add(t.ListColumns(1).DataBodyRange)
out=out & ";key-typed=" & EarlyKey(f) & ";key-object=" & DirectRange(f,"Key") & ";key-callbyname=" & P(f,"Key")
ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("J1:K5")
out=out & ";sheet-typed-set=" & EarlyRng(ws.Sort) & ";table-typed-after=" & EarlyRng(s)
Probe=out & ";final=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Application.EnableEvents=True
Application.Calculation=-4105
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=out & ";PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
Application.EnableEvents=True
Application.Calculation=-4105

Public HeldField As SortField
Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant,q As Object
If IsObject(CallByName(o,k,VbGet)) Then
Set q=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If q Is Nothing Then
P="Nothing"
ElseIf TypeName(q)="Range" Then
P="Range:" & q.Parent.Name & "!" & q.Address
Else
P=TypeName(q) & ":" & q.Name
End If
Else
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
P=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SetP(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
SetP="OK:" & P(o,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
SetP="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function M(o As Object,k As String,Optional a As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant
If IsMissing(a) Then
v=CallByName(o,k,VbMethod)
Else
v=CallByName(o,k,VbMethod,a)
End If
M=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
M="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function AddKey(s As Sort,k As Range,Optional direction As Long=1,Optional data As Long=0) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim f As SortField
Set f=s.SortFields.Add(k,0,direction,,data)
AddKey=TypeName(f) & ":" & P(f,"Key")
Exit Function
Failed:
AddKey="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,t As ListObject,s As Sort,c As Range,f As SortField,out As String
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
Set t=ws.ListObjects(1)
Set s=t.Sort
out="table=" & t.Name & ":" & t.Range.Address & ":headers=" & CStr(t.ShowHeaders) & ":totals=" & CStr(t.ShowTotals) & ";sort=" & P(s,"Rng") & ":h=" & P(s,"Header") & ":case=" & P(s,"MatchCase") & ":orientation=" & P(s,"Orientation") & ":method=" & P(s,"SortMethod") & ":fields=" & CStr(s.SortFields.Count) & "["
For Each f In s.SortFields
out=out & P(f,"Key") & ":" & P(f,"Order") & ":" & P(f,"DataOption") & "|"
Next
out=out & "];cells=["
For Each c In t.Range.Cells
out=out & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":nf=" & CStr(c.NumberFormat) & ":b=" & CStr(c.Font.Bold) & ":fill=" & CStr(c.Interior.Color) & "|"
Next
out=out & "];hidden=["
For Each c In t.Range.Rows
out=out & CStr(c.Row) & ":" & CStr(c.EntireRow.Hidden) & "|"
Next
Snapshot=out & "];worksheet=" & P(ws.Sort,"Rng") & ":fields=" & CStr(ws.Sort.SortFields.Count)
End Function
Function TryUdfSort() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant
v=Worksheets("Data").ListObjects(1).Sort.Apply
TryUdfSort=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v) & ":err=" & CStr(Err.Number)
Exit Function
Failed:
TryUdfSort="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function DirectRange(o As Object,k As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim r As Range
If k="Rng" Then
Set r=o.Rng
Else
Set r=o.Key
End If
If r Is Nothing Then
DirectRange="Nothing"
Else
DirectRange="Range:" & r.Parent.Name & "!" & r.Address
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
DirectRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function ObjectIdentity(t As ListObject,s As Sort) As String
ObjectIdentity="parent=" & CStr(s.Parent Is t) & ":application=" & CStr(s.Application Is Application) & ":again=" & CStr(s Is t.Sort)
End Function
Function EarlyRng(s As Sort) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim r As Range
Set r=s.Rng
EarlyRng="Range:" & r.Parent.Name & "!" & r.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
EarlyRng="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function EarlyKey(f As SortField) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim r As Range
Set r=f.Key
EarlyKey="Range:" & r.Parent.Name & "!" & r.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
EarlyKey="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
